verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway and router. A platform like this could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs, so the axis applies. However, its documented features cover only per-request behaviour: routing, fallbacks, load balancing, caching, analytics, and the MCP gateway. Nothing in the pack shows any scheduler, cron, recurring job, or workflow automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
